title: Every figure shares one design and one color palette
body:
## What exists today

Four benchmarks draw figures. Each one carries its own matplotlib scripts under `scripts/`, and the pdfs go flat into `figures/`.

| benchmark | scripts | figures |
|---|---|---|
| cloud-search | `plot.py` | the `(A, B)` heatmaps |
| loss-decomp | `plot.py`, `plot_depth.py` | `loss-decomp-hits.pdf`, `loss-decomp-depth-binned.pdf`, `loss-decomp-depth-cumulative.pdf` |
| pid | `plot.py`, `plot_pid.py`, `plot_roc.py`, `plot_time.py`, `plot_score.py`, `plot_cell_frac.py` | `pid.pdf`, `roc.pdf`, `time.pdf`, `cells.pdf` |
| thread-scaling | `plot.py` | `thread-scaling.pdf` |

## The change

Every figure looks like it belongs with the others. The design and the color palette are consistent across all of them.
